description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
